t: The Timeguard STW360 is a white, flush-mounted PIR sensor, engineered for reliable automatic lighting control in commercial and domestic indoor spaces. This motion sensor is ideal for areas like offices, stairwells, and utility rooms, offering enhanced energy efficiency and security. Its robust, lightweight construction and sleek design ensure seamless integration into ceilings. Features include a manual override, adjustable 'on' time from 3 seconds to 18 minutes, and light levels from 10 to 100Lux for tailored operation. Capable of switching 1000W incandescent or 200W LED/fluorescent loads. 360° detection angle with a 6m diameter detection coverage at a 2.5m mounting height. Suitable for 1000W resistive, 200W LED/Fluorescent or Low energy loads.
